step1.title: Designing Reactive SSR
step1.description:
Now that I have a Solid foundation for client-side reactivity, I've been revisiting SSR for the past few weeks. In this stream, we will discuss designing SSR to work with Async and what a reactive approach to SSR + Hydration might look like.
